name: MAGen generic MA-cross + ADX gate (ATR stop/TP, long+short)
author: Jesse community
license: MIT (repo LICENSE; individual authors per README)
indicators: slow MA (type 11, period 20), fast MA (type 11, period 5), ADX(8), ATR(32)
entry_long: fast MA crosses above slow MA AND ADX>13
entry_short: fast MA crosses below slow MA AND ADX>13
exit: long exit: fast<slow AND ADX<15; short mirror
implementation_notes: MA type index 11 maps to a specific jesse ma type; confirm mapping in jesse docs before porting. Jesse note: README states these are code examples, not profitable strategies.
